text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are holding flat over the past day, suggesting consolidation rather than conviction in either direction. The Fear & Greed index at 71 (Greed) and climbing indicates retail appetite is building, though BTC dominance at 58.7% shows investors are still comfortable rotating into altcoins like BNB. Volume at $77B is moderate, implying the greed sentiment hasn't yet translated into sustained breakout momentum.
